approach.title: Our approach to eCommerce growth
approach.desc1: At Persici, we work as a dedicated growth partner, with a deep understanding of the regional market and a focus on ROI. We deliver tailored strategies - not templates. No freelancers, no shortcuts - just a small, senior team focused on long-term, scalable results.
approach.desc2: We combine hands-on execution with clear communication: performance updates weekly, full WhatsApp access, and no surprises - only growth.

reviews.title: Words from those we scale

r1.name: Shab Stafford
r1.review: The best decision I made for my business! Handing over performance acquisition to someone else is not easy, but Persici delivered beyond expectations. Our monthly revenue grew 3.4x in five months.

r2.name: Varsha Mohandas
r2.review: Highly recommend Persici! They helped us with our paid social and search ad campaigns. Planning to our tailored unit economics, weekly sprint reporting, and proactive follow-ups were top notch.

r3.name: Maryam Sahem
r3.review: Thanks to Persici, our luxury DTC brand has experienced a remarkable surge in sales and glowing feedback. Their expertise in crafting compelling ads has elevated our brand to new heights.

r4.name: Tanya Shumeiko
r4.review: We have been working with Persici for over eight months and our blended ROAS reached 6.2x. Revenue tripled compared to our historical average. Seamless execution and deep integrity.

r5.name: Jm Fernández
r5.review: The Persici team has been an outstanding growth partner for all digital acquisition. Their understanding of GCC markets and CRO combined with our creative vision yielded record profits.

r6.name: Farah Y.
r6.review: I have been working with Persici for a year now. We scaled immensely and achieved 7.5x ROAS on Meta and TikTok. Strongly recommend to any ambitious DTC brand looking to scale.

r7.name: Alexander Holm
r7.review: The strategic clarity and direct weekly communication from the Persici team is unmatched. In 4 months, our international revenue grew over 210% with profitable ROAS.

r8.name: Nadia Bensalem
r8.review: Persici transformed our Shopify store speed, UI, and checkout conversion rate. Combined with their Meta ad scaling, our monthly GMV doubled within one quarter.
